title: Cape Cod Pirate Adventure Paddle Hunt and Battle
blurb:
Families can enjoy a unique pirate-themed adventure on the serene waters of Cape Cod. This 2-hour journey invites young explorers aged 8 and up to paddle, engage in a lively water cannon battle against a rogue pirate, and uncover hidden treasures. Expert guides ensure safety while igniting excitement with interactive storytelling and teamwork. It's the perfect way to enjoy a day out of the water, all while connecting with nature and creating lasting memories together.

Adventurers 2-7 are welcome to accompany an adult on their paddleboard.
